description.zh: 泡在英文内容里（文章、视频等），并和母语者闲聊，目标是能流畅阅读英文资料、用英语讲清技术方案。
description.en: Immersing in English content (articles, videos and more) and chatting with native speakers — aiming to read English material fluently and explain technical designs in English.

description.zh: 持续打磨 NetFountain 与 FluxMeld：回复 issue、补文档、重构与测试。开源最难的不是写代码，是持续在场。
description.en: Keep polishing NetFountain and FluxMeld: answering issues, writing docs, refactoring and testing. The hardest part of open source is showing up, not writing code.
